prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original painted medieval RTS animation sprite sheet. Image 1 is the character identity and art-style reference. Create exactly 16 separate complete full-body poses of a medieval hooded longbow archer, in a strict FOUR-column FOUR-row grid, read left to right then down. Frames 1–8 (top two rows) are a complete looping walk cycle with genuinely alternating leg positions, carrying the weapon naturally. Keep the brown hood, blue-and-tan tunic, leather boots and quiver. Carry a wooden longbow. Frames 9–16: bow ready, reach for arrow, nock, draw, RELEASE at frame 13, lower bow, recover, ready again. Do not draw a flying arrow; projectiles are rendered separately by the game. Same camera angle and facing throughout, matching the reference isometric view; same character scale, equipment, clothing, materials, palette and upper-left light in all cells. Fixed horizontal centre and ground-contact baseline per cell, generous transparent margins. Frame 9 must be a neutral ready/idle pose, suitable when the unit is standing still. Landscape 1536×1024, four equal columns and four equal rows. Detailed painted realistic medieval art, original game identity, blue recolourable cloth. Each cell contains ONLY its one character; absolutely no neighbouring fragments. Real transparent alpha background with alpha zero in every empty gap and corner. No background, gradient haze, ground, scenery, labels, text, cell borders, grid, duplicate poses, motion streaks, icons or pixel art.
